guardrails: Do not treat ATM route classification as final route preference.
Do not treat the A367 utility-corridor hypothesis as a preferred-route conclusion.
Do not treat Two Tunnels or Colliers Way greenway context as automatically preferred.
Do not claim car-mile reduction, school-run impact, formal funding eligibility, or route deliverability without supporting evidence.

sources.title: Active Travel Masterplan overview and embedded route map
sources.publisher: Bath and North East Somerset Council
sources.what_it_would_be_used_for: Identify official ATM route context, route-type language, masterplan objectives, and the council caveat that the network is continually reviewed.
sources.provenance_guidance: Record page URL, access date, and any linked map or document used for each route record.
sources.uncertainty_guidance: Treat the embedded map as official source context only; do not infer exact geometry or route preference from screenshots or page text.
sources.claim_limits: official context only; not route preference; no quantified car-mile reduction or school-run impact claims

sources.title: Active Travel Masterplan document library and appendices
sources.publisher: Bath and North East Somerset Council
sources.what_it_would_be_used_for: Review adopted ATM narrative, appendices, consultation report, and route network references for source evidence and caveats.
sources.provenance_guidance: Record document title, part number or appendix, publication or update date, page or section, and URL.
sources.uncertainty_guidance: Use document evidence to describe council source material, not to settle unresolved MVP questions about pilot geometry or preferred status.
sources.claim_limits: official context only; not route preference; no formal funding eligibility or route deliverability claims

sources.title: View and comment on planned Active Travel routes
sources.publisher: Bath and North East Somerset Council
sources.what_it_would_be_used_for: Inspect the current public route map and feedback framing for candidate ATM route evidence.
sources.provenance_guidance: Record page URL, access date, route labels visible in the map, and whether data was manually interpreted.
sources.uncertainty_guidance: Map iframe data may not provide reusable geometry; mark any manually captured geometry as indicative.
sources.claim_limits: candidate route context only; not route preference; no route deliverability claims

sources.title: Closed consultation evidence on existing active travel infrastructure
sources.publisher: Bath and North East Somerset Council
sources.what_it_would_be_used_for: Record council context for existing infrastructure including National Cycle Network, Norton Radstock greenway, Five Arches greenway, Bristol to Bath corridor, Avon cycleway, and Two Tunnels circuit.
sources.provenance_guidance: Record exact page section and whether the reference is existing infrastructure, planned scheme, or consultation background.
sources.uncertainty_guidance: Use as greenway/source context; do not treat greenway presence as an automatic everyday utility route conclusion.
sources.claim_limits: greenway source/context evidence; not automatically preferred; no school-run impact claims

sources.title: A367 utility-corridor hypothesis review inputs
sources.what_it_would_be_used_for: Track the hypothesis that an A367-aligned corridor through or near Odd Down, Peasedown St John, Radstock, Midsomer Norton, and Westfield may have everyday utility value.
sources.provenance_guidance: Record the hypothesis source, settlement names reviewed, and every official or advisory dataset checked against it.
sources.uncertainty_guidance: Keep values such as network_status, modal_shift_potential, and age12_standard_target as needs-review or unknown until supporting data is added.
sources.claim_limits: hypothesis only; not route preference; no car-mile reduction, school-run impact, funding eligibility, or deliverability claims

sources.title: Get Information about Schools
sources.what_it_would_be_used_for: Identify schools and education destinations in or near the pilot area for school access relevance review.
sources.provenance_guidance: Record URN, establishment name, status, phase, coordinates or address source, download date, and filter criteria.
sources.uncertainty_guidance: School presence supports destination context only; do not claim a route will reduce school-run traffic without observed or modelled travel evidence.
sources.claim_limits: destination context only; no school-run impact claims; no route preference claims

sources.title: OS Open Names
sources.what_it_would_be_used_for: Provide settlement, road, postcode, and named-place context for Bath, Odd Down, Peasedown St John, Radstock, Midsomer Norton, Westfield, and nearby destinations.
sources.provenance_guidance: Record product version or download date, feature identifiers where available, and any filtering used for the pilot area.
sources.uncertainty_guidance: Use for place context and labelling, not as evidence that a route serves a destination well.
sources.claim_limits: place-name context only; no modal shift or route preference claims

sources.title: National Cycle Network public GIS layer
sources.what_it_would_be_used_for: Identify National Cycle Network alignment and signed-route context near the pilot corridor.
sources.provenance_guidance: Record dataset item URL, update date, route identifiers, and whether the segment intersects or only contextualises the pilot area.
sources.uncertainty_guidance: The publisher warns the data may contain errors; use as NCN context, not definitive route-quality evidence.
sources.claim_limits: advisory NCN context only; not route preference; no route-quality conclusion

sources.title: National Public Transport Access Nodes
sources.what_it_would_be_used_for: Identify bus stops and other public transport access points that can inform bus-corridor-access and destination context.
sources.provenance_guidance: Record stop ATCO code, common name, coordinates, dataset download date, and any pilot-area filter.
sources.uncertainty_guidance: Stop presence is not service quality; pair with timetable evidence before implying useful bus integration.
sources.claim_limits: stop-location context only; no frequency, mode-shift, or route preference claims

sources.title: Bus Open Data Service
sources.what_it_would_be_used_for: Review timetable and service data for bus context where the pilot needs evidence of public transport integration.
sources.provenance_guidance: Record operator, service, timetable data date, API or download source, and any frequency summarisation method.
sources.uncertainty_guidance: Timetables require extraction and checking; do not treat route presence as reliable frequency evidence until processed.
sources.claim_limits: bus service context only; no mode-shift or funding eligibility claims

sources.title: Transport Connectivity Metric
sources.what_it_would_be_used_for: Explore area-level walking, cycling, public transport, and overall connectivity context for employment, education, shopping, leisure, and healthcare access.
sources.provenance_guidance: Record geography level, mode, purpose, data release, and whether public downloadable estimates or restricted tool outputs were used.
sources.uncertainty_guidance: Connectivity scores measure opportunity, not actual trips or route assignment; do not use them as direct route preference evidence.
sources.claim_limits: area connectivity context only; no route preference, car-mile reduction, or school-run impact claims

sources.title: Journey time statistics data tables
sources.what_it_would_be_used_for: Use legacy key-service travel-time tables as contextual evidence if the newer connectivity metric is not practical for the MVP.
sources.provenance_guidance: Record table ID, geography, mode, year, and service type used.
sources.uncertainty_guidance: The series has been discontinued; use only as background context and mark stale or legacy where used.
sources.claim_limits: legacy accessibility context only; no route preference or current travel-demand claims

sources.title: Cycle infrastructure design LTN 1/20
sources.what_it_would_be_used_for: Inform the age-12 independent travel target and broad intervention need language without doing section-level engineering audits.
sources.provenance_guidance: Record guidance title, publication date, section or principle cited, and any simplified interpretation used in the prototype.
sources.uncertainty_guidance: Use as design-standard context only; do not claim compliance or non-compliance without a route audit.
sources.claim_limits: quality-language guidance only; no route deliverability, funding eligibility, or engineering audit claims

sources.title: OpenStreetMap
sources.what_it_would_be_used_for: Check advisory road, path, crossing, access, and destination context where official sources are missing or need sense-checking.
sources.provenance_guidance: Record OSM object IDs, access date, tags used, and required OpenStreetMap attribution and licence handling.
sources.uncertainty_guidance: Community mapping can be incomplete or inconsistent; use as advisory context and avoid copying from incompatible sources.
sources.claim_limits: advisory context only; no official evidence, route preference, or deliverability claims

sources.title: Public rights of way online map
sources.publisher: Bath and North East Somerset Council
sources.what_it_would_be_used_for: Check public rights of way context where greenway or local-feeder routes may interact with recorded paths.
sources.provenance_guidance: Record page URL, access date, path references if visible, and whether the legal Definitive Map was checked.
sources.uncertainty_guidance: The council page says the online map is an indicative guide, not the legal record.
sources.claim_limits: indicative rights-of-way context only; no legal alignment, route preference, or deliverability claims

sources.title: Definitive Map and Statement
sources.publisher: Bath and North East Somerset Council
sources.what_it_would_be_used_for: Would be the legal source for public rights of way alignment where rights-of-way claims matter.
sources.provenance_guidance: If later used, record appointment date, map extract reference, statement reference, and permission or reuse constraints.
sources.uncertainty_guidance: Not suitable for the first prototype dataset because access appears appointment-based rather than a simple reusable open dataset.
sources.claim_limits: unavailable for MVP; no legal rights-of-way, route alignment, or deliverability claims

sources.title: Commercial mobile-network active travel data
sources.what_it_would_be_used_for: Could theoretically inform observed walking and cycling origin-destination demand if licensed and methodologically reviewed.
sources.provenance_guidance: Do not use unless licence, methodology, geography, sampling limits, and privacy handling are reviewed.
sources.uncertainty_guidance: Commercial, unreleased, or licence-limited data is not appropriate for a transparent checked-in MVP dataset.
sources.claim_limits: unsuitable for MVP; no observed-demand, car-mile reduction, or route preference claims
